backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining service packages and orders for social media marketing services (followers, likes, views) across platforms (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) with CRUD operations for packages and orders, storing prices in both cents and Moroccan Dirhams.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four completed features: replacing Add to Cart with WhatsApp contact button, hiding cart functionality, disabling checkout flow, and updating Hero CTA to emphasize WhatsApp communication over direct purchases.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including Arabic RTL layouts, service cards with WhatsApp integration, cart/checkout pages, admin dashboard with service/order management, and styling with dark theme and Arabic typography.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, defining color tokens for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Arabic language and RTL direction, Inter font from Google Fonts, and meta tags for SMM Ourprice social media marketing services application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router defining routes for home (Hero), services (ServicesPage), and admin (AdminDashboard), wrapped in ThemeProvider and CartProvider with shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashb: Admin dashboard container with three tabs: overview, services management, and orders table.
frontend/src/components/admin/DashboardO: Dashboard overview displaying key metrics (total orders, pending orders, total revenue) and recent activity list.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersTabl: Admin table for viewing all orders with customer details, status badges, and dropdown to update order status (pending/completed/cancelled).
frontend/src/components/admin/ServiceMan: Admin component for managing service packages with a table view, add/edit dialog, and toggle availability functionality. Integrates with backend queries for CRUD operations on service packages.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with SMM Ourprice branding, Arabic quick links navigation, social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), contact information with WhatsApp number, and copyright notice with Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with SMM Ourprice logo and Arabic navigation links (الرئيسية, الخدمات, لوحة التحكم) using TanStack Router with active state styling and RTL spacing.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Landing page hero section with animated logo, Arabic tagline, WhatsApp contact info, and feature cards showcasing followers, likes, and views services.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays individual service package cards with platform/service icons, quantity input, price calculation, and WhatsApp contact button for ordering.
frontend/src/components/ServicesPage.tsx: Main services page with platform tabs (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, TikTok) that filters and displays service cards by selected platform.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Automatically invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.tsx: React context and hook for managing shopping cart state, including add/remove items, update quantities, calculate totals, and clear cart functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient configuration with delegation handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend API calls including fetching services/orders, placing orders, adding/updating service packages, and updating order status.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming (light/dark mode), RTL direction support, and custom animation utilities (fade-in, slide-in, zoom-in).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Utility function to generate WhatsApp URLs with pre-filled Arabic messages for service package orders, including platform, service type, quantity, and pricing details.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including HSL-based color variables, border radius, Inter font family, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting an SMM services marketplace website with features for selling social media engagement products, Arabic localization, WhatsApp integration, admin dashboard, and shopping cart functionality with black/cyan branding.
